STORY-FEAT4-036.title: Implement NPI Registry Lookup Core Logic with Resilience
STORY-FEAT4-036.description: Implement and harden provider_detail_service logic to query CMS NPI Registry API, including timeout handling, null field normalization, and fallback behavior for incomplete provider records.

STORY-FEAT4-037.title: Integrate Provider Detail Lookup into EvaluateCare Facade
STORY-FEAT4-037.description: Wire provider detail lookup into evaluate_care_facade to enable orchestration with other Evaluate Care features and ensure consistent response formatting for downstream tool usage.

STORY-FEAT4-038.title: Create Unit and Integration Tests for Provider Detail Lookup
STORY-FEAT4-038.description: Develop unit tests for provider_detail_service and integration tests validating end-to-end provider detail retrieval through tool_router and facade, including edge cases like missing NPI and invalid responses.
